notes:
MegaArrow joins the family.

A new mod, MegaArrow, is now in the mod list: a volley arrow for any bow that fires one homing arrow per enemy in front of you (up to ten), all-or-nothing with the arrow you actually aimed. This MegaLoad update adds its icon in the mod list and the 'MegaArrow' tag in MegaBugs so tickets can be filed against it. No other changes.
